summary: Laevi was a Nomai child who grew up on Brittle Hollow and Ember Twin. Sibling of Lami and niece/nephew of Pye, Laevi enforced the blindfold rule in the Anglerfish game and later moved to the Statue Workshop on Giant's Deep with the other children.

behavior: Laevi insisted on rules being followed in the Anglerfish game.
location: Laevi grew up on Brittle Hollow and Ember Twin.
Laevi moved to the Statue Workshop on Giant's Deep with Lami and Taget during Ash Twin Project construction.
lore: Laevi was the sibling of Lami.
Laevi was the niece/nephew of Pye.
Laevi expected to grow tall like their parents.
Laevi played the Anglerfish game in the Sunless City with Taget, Ilex, Solanum, and Lami.
Laevi left instructions for kids too tall for the Anglerfish Overlook hole: go through the Stepping Stone Cave instead.
Laevi cited Pye's information that real Anglerfish are blind to add a blindfold rule to the game.
Laevi's blindfold rule was later softened by Ilex so younger kids did not have to wear one.
Laevi argued against Lami's plan to sneak into Phlox's dangerous memory-statue test, citing the risk.
Laevi died when Ghost Matter from the Interloper killed all Nomai in the solar system.
